LanguageData.Raven_Building_SewingBench.label: (Raven) Sewing Bench
LanguageData.Raven_Building_SewingBench.description: A precise sewing workbench designed specifically for the Raven race. Its structure accommodates the movement space of their wings, and it integrates tools for processing special fabrics and feathers.\n\nAll exclusive Raven race apparel is crafted here.
